# WO-008: Cover v0.2 JSON serialization edge cases
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Agent: test-quality
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via tools/vendor.sh)

## Goal
Hannah Cole: strengthen the v0.2 machine-readable CLI contract with
focused tests of existing pure serializers and stdout emission in
src/freemyid/cli_json.py. One or two sessions; no product changes.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Review tests/test_cli_json_headless.py first and add coverage for gaps,
  rather than duplicating its command-level happy paths.
- Cover status_doc, todos_doc, outbox_doc, reports_doc, and emit only.
  Use in-memory fake objects with fixed IDs and timezone-aware UTC dates;
  no store, real keychain, registry loading, subprocess, or network access.
- Check documented required fields, schema versions, JSON types, empty
  collections, and nullable timestamps/tier values where supported.
  Permit additive fields consistent with the versioning rule.
- Verify status broker ordering for shuffled inputs, fallback to broker ID
  for an unknown display name, and preservation of supplied skipped rows.
- Verify Unicode, quotes, backslashes, and embedded newlines in fake labels
  and titles survive JSON round-trip. A single emit call must write exactly
  one parseable JSON object followed by a newline, without human formatting
  or stderr output, including with long strings.
- Check repeated serialization of fixed inputs gives equal output and does
  not mutate inputs. Do not impose ordering the existing contract does not
  promise or assume all input timestamps are normalized by the serializer.
- Tests exercise actual serializers, with meaningful expected values from
  docs/CLI.md; do not merely compare output to a copy of implementation.
- Run `.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_cli_json_serialization_edges.py
  tests/test_cli_json_headless.py` and
  `.venv/bin/ruff check tests/test_cli_json_serialization_edges.py`.
  New Python is typed, compatible with Python 3.11+, and fake-data-only.
- If a contract bug appears, add a narrowly scoped `xfail(strict=True)`
  with a specific defect reason and report it at check-in. Do not change
  product behavior or weaken assertions to make the suite pass.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- tests/test_cli_json_serialization_edges.py

## Out of scope / do not touch
All product code and existing tests/fixtures; CLI documentation reserved
by WO-002; exposure serializers; consent/practice behavior and tests;
secrets, mail, storage, network, sending, security tests, private registry,
CI/release, dependencies, and every other open work order's files.
No git, network, package installs, or real data. Importing existing model
types for fake fixtures does not authorize changes to those models.

## Check-in plan
After session one: give the gap-to-test matrix and any contract defects.
At completion: report targeted test and lint results, explicit expected
failures, and any owner follow-up needed. Stop at the allowed paths.
